title: Add Google sign-in
body: Adds Google OAuth sign-in. Refresh tokens are rotated on every use. Updates docs/auth.md.
author: dev1
head: feat/google-signin

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+"""Google OAuth sign-in."""
+import time
+import httpx
+
+from auth.session import Session, create_session
+
+GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
+GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"
+
+
+class GoogleAuthError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def sign_in(code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> Session:
+    """Exchange an authorization code for a session."""
+    token = _exchange_code(code, redirect_uri)
+    profile = _fetch_profile(token["access_token"])
+    return create_session(profile["sub"], profile["email"])
+
+
+def _exchange_code(code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> dict:
+    response = httpx.post(GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL, data={
+        "code": code,
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,

     def _issue(self, user_id: str) -> str:
         token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
         self._store(user_id, token)
         return token
 
+    def rotate(self, token: str) -> str:
+        record = self._lookup(token)
+        if record is None or record.revoked:
+            raise SessionError("refresh token reused")
+        self._revoke(token)
+        return self._issue(record.user_id)
+
     def refresh(self, token: str) -> "Session":
         """Rotate the refresh token and return a fresh session."""

+### Sign in with Google
+Google sign-in exchanges the OAuth code server-side; no tokens reach the browser.
+
 Session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax.
